name: SPire
description: Personal cloud music streaming application — your music, your Google Drive, your rules.
author: Ishan Koirala
motto: Your music. Your Drive. Your rules.

frontend.styling: Tailwind CSS 4 + custom Liquid Glass design system
frontend.state_management: React Context (Auth, Player, Library, GlassVariant, AppleEdit)
frontend.ui_primitives: Radix UI + custom glasscn component library

storage.primary: Google Drive (user's own drive for audio files + custom backgrounds)
storage.preferences: localStorage (tile sizes, glass variant, session state)

integrations: Google Drive API (file upload, streaming, quota management)
iTunes Search API (metadata matching, artwork, artist photos)
Discord Embedded App SDK (in-browser activity + Rich Presence)
Discord Bot (Node.js — slash commands, voice channel streaming)

music_streaming.description: Stream audio directly from Google Drive via blob URL caching
how_it_works: User uploads audio files → stored in Google Drive
Audio metadata parsed client-side (mp3, wav, flac support)
iTunes API match enriches metadata (title, artist, artwork, genre)
On play: Drive file fetched as blob → URL.createObjectURL → <audio> element
Blob URLs cached to avoid re-fetching during session
Fallback: Supabase stream-track edge function proxy when Drive quota exceeded
key_files: src/utils/driveApi.js — Drive streaming, blob caching, token management

library_management.description: Full music library with search, playlists, likes, and genre organization
data_flow: On login: Supabase query → user_tracks + tracks + track_metadata + track_lyrics + artists
Results formatted into unified track objects with cover URLs
iTunes artwork fetched for tracks missing covers
Library stored in LibraryContext, accessible app-wide
features: Favorite/like songs (synced to Supabase liked_songs table)
Recently played / recently added smart playlists
Track deletion (removes from Supabase + Google Drive)
key_files: src/lib/deleteTrack.js — Track deletion with Drive cleanup

playback_controls.description: Full player with shuffle, repeat, queue, and keyboard shortcuts

queue_system.description: Context-aware queue that changes based on playback origin
queue_types: Artist queue — all tracks by current artist, sorted by upload date
Playlist queue — tracks from active playlist
Radio queue — algorithmic recommendations based on station genre
Library queue — entire library as fallback
queue_system.preloading: Next track's audio preloaded into memory via preloadAudio()

radio_mode.description: Internet radio-style playback with genre-based stations and real-time sync
how_it_works: User selects a station from the dropdown in MusicBar
Recommendation engine scores library tracks by genre/artist affinity
Queue built from top-scoring tracks matching station genre
Station anchor (track index + offset) persisted in localStorage
On track end: auto-advance to next track in station queue
Pause > 30s: re-tune to live position (like real radio)
Listen Together: radio state broadcast via Supabase Realtime

spatial_audio.description: Web Audio API effects: 8D binaural panning, reverb, nightcore pitch shift
effects: 8D Audio — auto-panning left/right with configurable speed
Reverb — convolution reverb with impulse response generation
Nightcore — pitch shift up + tempo increase
spatial_audio.implementation: Source → GainNode → optional effects chain → destination

karaoke.description: Record yourself singing along with synced lyrics display
how_it_works: KaraokeView shows synced lyrics alongside playback controls
Recordings stored in IndexedDB via recordingsStore
RecordingsView lists all saved recordings with playback/download/delete

synced_lyrics.description: Time-synced lyrics that auto-follow playback position
features: Click to seek to any line
Highlight active line with glow effect

library_sharing.description: Share your music library with friends via email invite
flow: Owner enters grantee's email in LibrarySharing component
On accept: grantee can browse owner's library in read-only mode
Shared tracks marked isShared=true (no delete controls)
Real-time updates via Supabase Realtime postgres_changes

discord_integration.description: Run SPire inside Discord as an Embedded Activity + bot for voice channels
embedded_activity: SPire runs in Discord's embedded browser
Captures Discord user identity via SDK
Links to Supabase account via link-discord edge function
Posts Rich Presence with current track info

discord_bot.voice_streaming: Streams audio from Google Drive to Discord voice channels
discord_bot.account_linking: 6-digit code system via linking_codes + redeem-link-code tables

key_files: bot/driveStream.js — Drive audio streaming for bot

background_system.description: Customizable video/image wallpapers with crossfade transitions
features: 35+ preset wallpapers (20 Pexels videos + 15 Unsplash images)
Custom background upload to Google Drive

apple_edit_mode.description: iOS-style resizable grid tiles with jiggle animation (like Apple Control Center)
features: Long-press any tile (460ms) enters edit mode
Curved resize handle (bottom-right) to cycle through 4 sizes
key_files: src/context/AppleEditContext.jsx — Edit mode state + size persistence

listen_together.description: Real-time playback sync across devices via Supabase Realtime

steps: 1. User clicks 'Continue with Google'
2. Supabase Auth redirects to Google OAuth consent screen
3. Google redirects back with auth code + provider_token (access_token)
4. AuthContext stores session, sets driveAccessToken in localStorage
5. store-google-token edge function stores refresh_token server-side
6. On subsequent loads: getSession() restores session from Supabase
7. If token stale (>50min): refresh-google-token edge function refreshes
8. Fallback: Google Identity Services mints new token in browser
1. User selects audio file(s) in HomeView
2. DuplicateFileDialog checks for existing files with same name
3. processAudioUpload() orchestrates the pipeline:
a. Parse audio metadata (mp3→music-metadata-browser, wav→custom, flac→flac.js)
b. Search iTunes API for metadata match
c. Fetch high-res artwork from iTunes or LRCLIB
d. Search LRCLIB for synced lyrics
e. Upload audio file to Google Drive via driveService
f. Register in Supabase: tracks, track_metadata, track_lyrics, user_tracks, artists
4. Track appears in library immediately (optimistic update)
5. Artist photo sync runs in background
1. User clicks track → handlePlayTrack() in PlayerContext
2. activeTrack set, isPlaying=true
3. AudioPlayer effect triggers loadAudioSource()
4. If track has driveFileId: fetch blob from Drive API
5. If Drive fetch fails (401/429): refresh token → retry
6. If still fails: try Supabase stream-track edge function
7. Blob URL created → audio.src set → audio.load()
8. Wait for 'canplay' event → apply seekTime → play()
9. onTimeUpdate fires → setCurrentTime → UI updates
10. On ended: handleTrackEnded → next track or repeat

users.rls: Users can read/update own profile. Library shares grantee can read owner profile.

tracks.rls: Authenticated users can read all. Inserts via edge functions.

playlist_tracks.rls: Users can manage own playlist tracks.

artists.rls: Authenticated users can read all. Updates scoped to photo_url+bio.

library_shares.rls: Owner can CRUD. Grantee can read + accept. Public read via token.

store-google-token.purpose: Store Google OAuth refresh_token server-side (never exposed to client)

refresh-google-token.purpose: Refresh Google access_token using stored refresh_token

get-drive-access-token.purpose: Bot-facing: returns valid Drive access_token for a discord_id

link-discord.purpose: Link Discord user_id to Supabase user

fetch-artist-photo.purpose: Fetch artist photo from iTunes API

stream-track.purpose: Proxy audio stream from Google Drive (fallback when direct access fails)

delete-track.purpose: Delete track from Supabase + Google Drive

ui_design_system.name: Liquid Glass
ui_design_system.description: GPU-composited glassmorphism design system with CSS rim highlights
ui_design_system.core_component: LiquidGlass — backdrop-blur + saturate with configurable rim light
special_components: StickyGlassHeader — Apple-style sticky header with dynamic shrink on scroll
InfiniteCarousel — Infinite scrolling with scroll position persistence
AppleResizableGrid/Tile — iOS-style resizable grid with jiggle animation
BackgroundManager — Video/image wallpaper system with crossfade
PlaylistPoster — Playlist cover art generation (Apple/Spotify variants)
TrackCard — Track tile with play overlay, playlist add, delete

src/.App.jsx: Root component — screen routing (opening → landing → app)
src/.main.jsx: ReactDOM render with BrowserRouter, AuthProvider, GlassVariantProvider, AppleEditProvider
src/.index.css: Tailwind imports, custom fonts, glass utilities, scrollbar styles, squircle corners

context/.AuthContext.jsx: Google OAuth, session management, token refresh chain
context/.PlayerContext.jsx: Playback state, queue, shuffle, repeat, radio, spatial audio
context/.LibraryContext.jsx: Library data, playlists, likes, artist sync, genre playlists
context/.AppleEditContext.jsx: Apple-style edit mode, tile sizes, removed tiles

components/.AppLayout.jsx: Main authenticated shell (background, search, content, player, modals)
components/.MusicBar.jsx: Bottom player bar with controls, volume, radio dropdown
components/.GlassSearchBar.jsx: Top search bar with navigation, glass style toggle
components/.TrackCard.jsx: Track tile with play overlay, playlist add, delete
components/.SyncedLyrics.jsx: Time-synced lyrics with auto-follow and seek

artist/.ArtistOverview.jsx: Artist profile page (latest release, popular tracks)

ui/.AppleResize.jsx: Apple-style resizable grid + tile with jiggle

views/.HomeView.jsx: Home feed — artists carousel, recently added, all songs grid
views/.KaraokeView.jsx: Karaoke recording studio with synced lyrics
views/.SettingsView.jsx: Account, Discord, sharing, background, display settings

hooks/.useSpatialAudio.js: Web Audio API effects (8D, reverb, nightcore)

services/.uploadPipeline.js: Upload orchestration (parse → iTunes → artwork → lyrics → Drive → Supabase)
services/.driveService.js: Drive API operations (upload, delete, quota, background)
services/.itunesService.js: iTunes search API (metadata, artwork, artist photos)
services/.discordService.js: Discord SDK integration (connect, activity, user detection)

utils/.driveApi.js: Drive streaming, blob caching, token management, quota detection
utils/.formatters.js: Time formatting, URL building, file size formatting
utils/.imageUtils.js: Image/video URL detection, color extraction, Unsplash optimization

lib/.googleTokenClient.js: Google Identity Services token client (browser fallback)
lib/.deleteTrack.js: Track deletion with Drive file cleanup

constants/.navigation.js: NAV_ITEMS array (home, explore, karaoke, playlists, settings)
constants/.radioStations.js: RADIO_STATIONS definitions with genres and frequencies

supabase/.migrations/: 21 SQL migration files (schema, RLS, security hardening)

bot/.index.js: Discord bot main entry (commands, queue, voice)

security.rls: Row-Level Security enabled on all tables
security.oauth_tokens: Locked table — only service_role can read/write
security.session_management: 30-day absolute session lifetime, 50-min token staleness check
security.token_refresh: Server-side refresh via edge functions (refresh_token never in browser)
security.discord_linking: 6-digit code system with expiration, one-time use

performance.blob_caching: Audio blob URLs cached in memory, revoked after 10s grace period
performance.preloading: Next track preloaded into memory via preloadAudio()
performance.image_optimization: Unsplash images served at optimal size via URL params
performance.code_splitting: Vite automatic chunk splitting (vendor, supabase, react)
performance.optimistic_updates: UI updates immediately on user actions, rolls back on failure
